data.name: Rat Hunt
data.detailed_description:
Hold still... or become lunch!

You're a rat the size of a teaspoon, loose in an overgrown backyard, and there's a hungry hawk overhead

that can spot the tiniest twitch. Rat Hunt is a chaotic, friendship-testing party game of hide-and-FREEZE.

Round up a crowd, hold your breath, and whatever you do... don't move.

Squeak! It's "Don't Move"

Here's the whole game in two words: movement gives you away. Sprint and you're a blur no hawk

could miss. Go perfectly still and the grass swallows you whole. Every dash for cheese or cover is a

gamble, and the hawk's gaze is your warning light: where it's looking is where it's hunting. Freeze,

read it, breathe.

Squeak! It's "Hold Your Nerve"

Hiding isn't passive. When a hawk looms over your bush, your rat starts to panic: the screen

shakes and a nerve mini-game kicks in. Keep your cool and hold steady and the hawk eventually gives up

and you outlast the camp. Crack under the pressure and you squeak, pop out of the grass, and get

snatched. The closer and louder the hawk, the harder your nerve holds. It's the tensest staring

contest you'll ever lose to a bird.

Squeak! It's "Hide and Seek + Red Light Green Light"

The hawk doesn't win dogfights, it wins investigations. Glide up to a fence post or the BBQ to scout,

loom over a suspicious bush to crank the pressure, and when a rat cracks it bolts into the open. Pop your Screech ultimate to flush every shaking rat in range at once.

Squeak! It's "Fight Back"

Rats aren't helpless. Team up, bait the hawk off a cornered friend, and time your Taunt ultimate

to take the heat yourself and relocate a teammate to safety. And in Escape mode you go on the

offensive: gnaw open a fence panel, break a hole in the perimeter, and slip out to the OUTSIDE.

Every rat that escapes is banked as a permanent win. Bank enough of the crew before the timer runs out

and the rats take the round.

Squeak! It's "Caught = Converted"

Get snatched and you don't just sit and watch. You come back as a hawk and turn on your former

friends. Every catch tips the yard further toward the predators, until the last few rats are scrambling

to outlast a sky full of hunters. Betrayal has never been so adorable.

Squeak! It's "Proximity Voice"

Talk to the players around you with built-in proximity voice chat, and only the players around you. Rats

squeak like squeaky little rats; hawks rumble like something with very big talons. Whisper a plan to a

nearby friend to pull off the perfect escape... or panic out loud and hand your hiding spot to the hawk

gliding right over your head. Sound is risk. Your mouth is a tool AND a liability.

Squeak! It's "Your Party, Your Rules"

Play with friends, or with total strangers. Host your own game behind a private room code, or leave it

public and let anyone drop right in. Pick your win mode (Last Rat Standing or [b]Escape), set

the round timer, the player count, the starting hawks, and the hawk and rat speed. Streamers can spin up

viewer-participation matches in seconds. Recommended for 2 to 16 players. The exact maximum depends on

the host's network environment and may rise or fall as we keep playtesting.

Squeak! It's "Style"

A cozy, miniature tilt-shift backyard: towering blades of grass, forgotten garden junk, a bird bath the

size of a lake, and a fence on its very last legs. Earn cosmetic rat and hawk skins just by playing. No

microtransactions, no nonsense. Just play and unlock.

[About Videos & Streaming]

Gameplay videos and streaming are very welcome! Two quick asks:

  • Include the game's name ("Rat Hunt") in your title. (Required)

  • Include the Steam store page URL in your description. (Optional)

Round up your friends. Hold your breath. And whatever you do... DON'T MOVE.

data.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game: a swarm of tiny rats must outlast hungry hawks in a giant backyard. The twist? Moving gives you away, so freeze to vanish in the grass. Whisper to friends with proximity voice... if you dare. Get caught and you JOIN the hunt.
